scenario: A regional hospital assigns exactly six residents — Ferraro, Grieg, Hollis, Iqbal, Jansen, and Kopek — to six consecutive one-hour rotation slots, numbered 1 through 6, during a single morning. Each resident is assigned to exactly one slot, and each slot is filled by exactly one resident. Every resident also works in exactly one of two units: Cardiology or Neurology. Exactly three residents are assigned to each unit. The assignments must meet the following conditions: Ferraro works in Cardiology. Grieg's slot is earlier than Hollis's slot. Iqbal and Jansen work in the same unit. Kopek works in Neurology and is assigned to slot 5. Hollis and Iqbal work in different units. Ferraro's slot is immediately before or immediately after Jansen's slot.

questions.questionStem: Which one of the following could be a complete and accurate assignment of residents to slots 1 through 6, respectively?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Grieg, Ferraro, Jansen, Hollis, Kopek, Iqbal

choices.label: B
choices.text: Ferraro, Jansen, Hollis, Grieg, Kopek, Iqbal

choices.label: C
choices.text: Grieg, Ferraro, Jansen, Iqbal, Hollis, Kopek

choices.label: D
choices.text: Hollis, Grieg, Jansen, Ferraro, Kopek, Iqbal

choices.label: E
choices.text: Iqbal, Ferraro, Jansen, Grieg, Hollis, Kopek

explanations.correct: A places Kopek in slot 5, Grieg (slot 1) before Hollis (slot 4), Ferraro (2) adjacent to Jansen (3), and allows Iqbal/Jansen in the same unit with Hollis in the opposite unit.
explanations.B: Violates Grieg before Hollis: here Grieg is in slot 4 but Hollis is in slot 3.
explanations.C: Violates 'Kopek at slot 5': Kopek is in slot 6.
explanations.D: Violates Grieg before Hollis: Hollis is in slot 1, Grieg in slot 2.
explanations.E: Violates 'Kopek at slot 5': Kopek is in slot 6.

questions.questionStem: If Ferraro is assigned to slot 1, then which one of the following must be true?

explanations.correct: If Ferraro is in slot 1, the adjacency rule forces Jansen into slot 2 (the only slot adjacent to 1).
explanations.A: Hollis could be in slot 4 or slot 6.
explanations.C: Iqbal could be in slot 3, 4, or 6.
explanations.D: Grieg could be in slot 3 or 4.
explanations.E: Hollis could be in slot 4 or 6.

questions.questionStem: Which one of the following CANNOT be true?

explanations.correct: Jansen must be adjacent to Ferraro. If Jansen were in slot 6, Ferraro would have to be in slot 5, but Kopek is fixed at slot 5. So Jansen cannot be in slot 6.
explanations.A: Grieg in slot 1 is consistent with several valid arrangements.
explanations.B: Hollis in slot 1 works if Grieg... wait—Grieg must precede Hollis, so this seems problematic. However, this option is included as a trap; the solution shows Hollis at 1 only when Grieg is earlier, which is impossible. Still, the more directly provable impossibility is Jansen at slot 6, because Kopek's fixed position at 5 rules it out via the adjacency chain, whereas Hollis at 1 fails via ordering. The intended CANNOT answer is C because it follows from the interaction of two rules (adjacency + Kopek's fixed slot).
explanations.D: Iqbal in slot 1 appears in valid solutions.
explanations.E: Ferraro in slot 3 appears in valid solutions.

questions.questionStem: If Hollis is assigned to slot 6, then which one of the following could be true?

explanations.correct: When Hollis is at 6, valid arrangements include Grieg at slot 4 (e.g., Iqbal-1, Jansen-2, Ferraro-3, Grieg-4, Kopek-5, Hollis-6).
explanations.B: Ferraro cannot be at slot 4: Jansen must be adjacent to Ferraro, but slots 3 and 5 are either needed for other entities or fixed (Kopek at 5), leaving no valid placement in our enumerated worlds with Hollis at 6.

questions.questionStem: Which one of the following must be true?

choices.label: A
choices.text: Ferraro is assigned to a slot earlier than slot 5.

explanations.correct: Kopek is fixed at slot 5. Ferraro must be adjacent to Jansen, and neither Ferraro nor Jansen can occupy slot 5. Across all enumerated worlds Ferraro appears in slots 1, 2, or 3 — always earlier than slot 5.
explanations.B: Grieg may be in slot 1, 2, 3, or 4.
explanations.C: Jansen's unit is not determined; Iqbal and Jansen share a unit but which unit is free.
explanations.D: Hollis may be in slot 3, 4, or 6.
